intro: Exposome studies frequently use openly available datasets to explore the interactions between environmental exposures and health outcomes, or as inputs for the modelling of more complex exposures. Below is a partial list of open datasets that have been used in EXPANSE and ExposomeNL studies, and data platforms that provide access to even more exposome-related datasets.

items.name: Urban heat island effect
items.description: Temperature difference between the city and the countryside

items.name: Methane (CH4)
items.description: Atmospheric CH4 observations derived from satellite radiances

items.name: National noise level
items.source: National Institute for Public Health and the Environment (Nationaal Georegister)

items.name: Light intensity at night
items.description: Remote sensing night-time lights composites from VIIRS

items.name: Climate Data Store
items.description: Data catalogue containing datasets about Earth's past, present and future climate

items.name: Atlas of the Living Environment (Atlas Leefomgeving)
items.description: Data catalogue and information site with datasets on environmental themes in the Netherlands
